gloss: breath through the nose; snorting; spirit

definitions.explanation: The air breathed out through the nose, especially when it is loud or forceful.
Figuratively, a person's eagerness or temper, in two idioms: {鼻息|はないき}が{荒|あら}い (to be fired up, raring to go) and {鼻息|はないき}を{窺|うかが}う (to watch someone's mood, to curry favor).

examples.english: I can hear the dog breathing through its nose.

examples.japanese: ⟦{馬|うま}→馬：01865_uma⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{白|しろ}い→白い：00587_shiroi⟧{鼻息|はないき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{吐|は}いた→吐く：04397_haku⟧。
examples.english: The horse snorted out white breath.

notes:
